mapper.select: SELECT w.balance, b.bank_name AS bankName, b.account_num AS accountNum FROM wallets w LEFT JOIN bank_accounts b ON w.user_id = b.user_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.is_main DESC, b.account_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT account_id AS accountId, bank_name AS bankName, account_num AS accountNumMasked, is_main AS isMain FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY is_main DESC, account_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_transactions ( wallet_id, payment_type, amount, balance_snapshot, related_id, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{paymentType}, #{amount}, #{balanceSnapshot}, #{relatedId}, #{status}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT wallet_id AS walletId, balance FROM wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT wt.wallet_trans_id AS walletTransId, wt.wallet_id AS walletId, wt.payment_type AS paymentType, wt.amount AS amount, wt.balance_snapshot AS balanceSnapshot, wt.related_id AS relatedId, wt.status AS status, wt.created_at AS createdAt FROM wallet_transactions wt JOIN wallets w ON wt.wallet_id = w.wallet_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY wt.created_at DESC
